gen-gf-sniglet-fs-amulya: Round, stubby and a little blunt. Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling, all in one quiet level beat, while Amulya keeps generous gaps in its curves for modern, easy text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bent-paperclip letters with no swelling anywhere, bold and distinctive in Sniglet, set over a body with shallow terminal curls. Sniglet grabs attention in a display; Encode Sans SC just gets on with the words.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-m-plus-code-latin: M PLUS Code Latin reads approachable and clean, like neon tubing bent into letters. Under Sniglet's blunt, level display forms, its pitcher-wide c gives the pair a friendly, commanding quality.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-special-gothic: Special Gothic reads approachable and modern, its rounded letters staying open and inviting from line to line. Sniglet's blunt terminals give the pair its backbone.
gen-gf-sniglet-space-grotesk: Sniglet leads with terminals that stop short of curling, one quiet, level beat. Space Grotesk takes over below, its counters breathing like a cut reed, and the ribbon-like glyphs keep the geometry crisp.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-cossette-titre: Expressive, with stencil bridges cutting wide gaps between letters. Cossette Titre sits below with open bowls and capitals barely taller than its lowercase, so Snowburst One gets all the drama while the text stays quiet.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-newa: Stencil bridges and a sprung-paper-clip opening make Snowburst One's tall lowercase loud and unmistakable. Noto Sans Newa answers with an open e and roomy bowls.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana is approachable and sturdy. Beneath Snowburst One's stencil shout, its wide channels and big open forms would keep a long passage moving easily, without a snag.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-open-sans: Stenciled, tall and loud. Open Sans brings a smooth read with no clogged curves, and that bulky lowercase is the pair's strongest quality beside Snowburst One's cut-sheet drama.
gen-gf-sono-fs-karma: Karma feels trustworthy and classic. Sono's scattered, wide-set terminals and short ascenders sit above Karma's calm modulation and tight cap-to-lowercase height, so modern and traditional share a page.
